description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ClientObserver' for client-wide observer implementations within the Orleans framework. It contains a single abstract method for retrieving an observer ID based on a client ID.

classes.name: ClientObserver
classes.description: An abstract base class for specialized client-wide observers.

methods.name: GetObserverGrainId
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the observer's grain ID given a client grain ID.
